fullContentHtml:
SSC JHT Tier-I Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Tier-I Answer Key for the post of Junior Hindi Translator (JHT)/ Junior Translation Officer (JTO)/ Junior Translator (JT), Junior Translation Officer (JTO) & Senior Hindi Translator (SHT)/Senior Translator (ST)/ Senior Translation Officer (STO) on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 303 posts. The online application process for SSC JHT Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 23 April 2026, to 14 May 2026. The examination was held on 08 September 2026. Candidates must download their SSC JHT Tier-I Answer Key 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 April 2026
  • Last Date : 14 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 19-20 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 31 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 05 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SSC JHT Tier-I Answer Key 2026?

SSC JHT Tier-I Answer Key 2026 contains the official answers. Candidates can verify their responses and submit objections if required.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
